citations.title: Travel policy, section 2.1: Booking flights
citations.cited_text: Book all flights through the company travel portal at least 14 days before departure. Economy class is the default for every employee. Flights longer than 6 hours in the air may be booked in premium economy with written approval from your director.

content.text: Premium economy is allowed on long flights.

citations.cited_text: Room upgrades are reimbursable when you note this on the expense report.

content.text: Business class is fine for executives.
Meals are capped at 100 US dollars per day while traveling.
